environment_contract_findings: The release vendors a standalone HumanEval-derived scorer (cert/pandas-numpy-eval) with a console entry point and a shipped example sample file, separable from the generation script we originally reached.
In the documented environment the scorer runs on the release's own shipped samples and emits pass@1 = 0.0693. The portable failure was our environment.
The HumanEval exec guard is already uncommented in the shipped code, so no repair was needed to make the scorer execute.
